summary: This bill allows electric utilities to combine hazard mitigation activities with power restoration efforts funded by federal disaster relief and ensures that receiving emergency power restoration assistance does not disqualify them from other hazard mitigation aid.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Stafford Act to allow electric utilities to carry out hazard mitigation activities in conjunction with power restoration efforts and remain eligible for other hazard mitigation assistance. While it doesn't directly appropriate new funds, it clarifies and potentially expands the scope of activities that can receive federal assistance under existing disaster relief programs, which could lead to increased government spending on hazard mitigation for electric utilities.
